title: Windows Server 2028 to drop WoW64 by default, 32-bit apps need manual add
summary: Microsoft said at Ignite 2026 that Windows Server 2028 will ship without the WoW64 compatibility subsystem by default, so 32-bit applications will not run out of the box. The release is planned for fall 2027 alongside Windows 11 27H2. Administrators who need 32-bit support can add WoW64 back as a Feature on Demand, typically through PowerShell or DISM on Server Core. Microsoft cited reducing attack surface and blocking 32-bit malware as the rationale; Windows 11 still includes WoW64 and Microsoft has not announced a removal plan for it.
